name: Cable Shoulder Press
steps: Stand centered between two low pulleys with feet shoulder-width apart or staggered.
Hold one handle outside each shoulder with palms facing forward and forearms vertical.
Brace your core and press both handles overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower each handle under control back beside your shoulders.
tips: Avoid leaning back or flaring your ribs as your arms pass your ears.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows slightly in front of your torso at the bottom.
